characters.role: Elder sister returning home and keeper of the central promise
characters.psychological_depth: Protective, guilty, observant, and torn between truth and family peace.

characters.role: Younger brother who stayed behind to carry family duties
characters.psychological_depth: Loyal and wounded; his anger hides years of devotion and exhaustion.

characters.role: Late mother whose letters and silences shape the plot
characters.psychological_depth: Tender, pragmatic, secretive, and afraid that truth may destroy the children she wants to protect.

characters.role: Younger sister who challenges the family's accepted memories
characters.psychological_depth: Sharp, independent, emotionally honest, and unwilling to inherit silence.

characters.role: Absent father whose choices created the family's central wound
characters.psychological_depth: Charismatic, evasive, proud, and remembered differently by every child.
